children.text: Three people. One slice. Classic scenario. What to do. What to do. I mean, nobody wants to be the one to take the last slice.
Let me get yours, Porky. I still feel bad about you losing your job.
Oh, no, it's okay. I got a new job. I'm doing catering.
Catering? Nobody wants a pig handling their food. Besides, isn't that a lot of temptation? I mean, your name's not Health and Fitness Pig. It's Porky Pig. Am I right?
Couldn't you at least pretend to reach for your wallet?
I don't have a wallet. Besides, I shouldn't have to pay. It's my birthday.
Your birthday's not until next week.
Oh, we're well within the birthday zone.
Hey, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa. Slow down.
You're the one who got stuck with a bill.
She'll have the cast off in about six weeks.
I was out buying cupcakes when I noticed a baby stuck on top of a building.
I knew I had to save that baby.
So I finished my cupcake and shimmied up the drainpipe when suddenly the drainpipe started coming loose from the building.
And you fell and broke your leg?
I let go of the drainpipe just in time and grabbed hold of a telephone wire.
So there I was, hanging from the wire.
I started swinging myself back and forth until finally I flung myself as high as I could, hoping I would make it to the roof.
But I didn't make it to the roof.
I was totally out of control and I went crashing through a giant plate glass window.
And that's when you broke your leg?
I landed flat on my back in the middle of some girl's apartment.
We're totally having lunch next week.
Anyway, I found my way to the elevator, but it was out of service.
So I had to pry open the doors and throw myself into the elevator shaft.
You fell down an elevator shaft?
I pulled myself up hand over hand until I finally reached the top where I kicked the grate open with my feet and catapulted myself onto the roof.
But right before I could grab the baby, it turned and I realized it wasn't a baby.
I tried to fend it off, but he was one of those angry crows and no matter what I did, he kept attacking.
He wouldn't stop and he just kept attacking and attacking until finally I lost my balance and fell 15 stories.
And that when you broke your leg?
I landed on an inflatable gorilla in front of a car dealership.
So how did you break your leg?
Oh, I was here for a checkup and I slipped getting up on this table.
How am I supposed to get inside?
So you don't have a wallet or keys?
I'm not interested in material possessions.
Just take me to your house.
Um, uh, can't I drop you off at Tina's?
Why don't you want to take me to your house?
All I'm saying is you need to be charming to do catering.
Uh, I've got something cooking to do.
You should get a job where you don't have to interact with people.
Maybe something with a computer where people don't have to look at you.
Because you're a creepy recluse who keeps to himself.
...news in the case of the suburban strangler.
Until now, the police have had little to go on
other than the assumption that the killer is a creepy recluse who keeps to himself.
That's how I just described Porky.
But now a witness has come forward,
giving police a physical description of the suspect.
The guy we're looking for is chubby, short, and bald, with a pig-like nose.
Chubby, short, and bald, with a pig-like nose?
If you see anyone matching this description, call 911.
Ah, I don't remember the number for 911.
I'll call 411 and ask them for the number for 911.
He's filled with useless information like emergency phone numbers.
I just didn't expect you to be standing there like a psychopath.
I should probably be getting home.
I'm sure Bugs is back by now.
They say never let your attacker take you to a second location.
If you drive me to my house, you'd be taking me to a second location.
But you're not taking me anywhere.
Awfully sensitive for a wanted killer.
Thanks for getting all my stuff.
I really feel like I'm at home.
Remind me again why you're not at home?
Because you're taking care of me, and you live here.
You won't even know I'm here.
Would you mind getting me a glass of milk?
Just give me the milk, and we'll see what happens.
When do you get your cast off again?
This is either the bedroom of an 80-year-old woman, or a deranged killer.
How many sunglasses does one pig need?
Is it possible that Porky's not the suburban strangler?
Could it be that he just happens to be chubby, short, and bald?
And I'm jumping to an outlandish conclusion because I'm a paranoid, hateful, fear-mongerer?
No, that's the face of a killer.
I think he's on to me.
Come pick up Daffy when I'm done with him.
I was just getting a little hungry.
He's gonna chop me up into a million pieces.
This is Porky you're talking about.
You've known him your whole life.
I've fallen in love with my captor.
I just realized I'm not hungry.
I think I should slide back down.
I thought this was the bathroom.
I have some business to attend to.
I have some business to attend to.
That's what a killer says right before he kills.
Or is it get in the van?
It's I have some business to attend to.
I thought I heard you downstairs.
Can I bring you some tea?
Why do I want to go in there?
Because I was told not to and I have a problem with authority.
I felt so bad that you were having to carry me up and down so I had one installed while
Chinese food's flat and round with cheese and tomato sauce and a bunch of different
I think I have to pee again.
Then you leave me no choice.
I mean, I probably do, but I don't want...
No, it's early, but you said you knew my secret, so I hope you like it.
A collage made out of assorted photos of me?
What on earth would possess you to make something this creepy?
Uh, because that's what you specifically told me you wanted for your birthday?
So you don't want to murder me?
Why would I want to murder you?
Only a murderer would ask that question.
What did you do to Speedy?
Look who's got a wallet and keys now, chubby!
Hey, Pinky was planning to throw this on your actual birthday, but he called and said
we'd have to do it tonight because you were getting suspicious.
You're lucky to have such a nice friend.
He trapped me in his home.
He locked the door so I couldn't escape.
Well, then, how come I couldn't just open it like this?
Kids use it all the time.
What does matter is that you cut the phone line so I couldn't call for help.
Are you talking about the phone in the guest room?
Then how do you explain the blood on your hands?
This is paint for the banner I made for your party.
You may have all these people fooled, but I saw you murder a woman.
That was an ice sculpture of you.
I thought that was supposed to be next week.
We interrupt this program with a special alert.
The Suburban Strangler has been captured.
You gotta admit there's a strong resemblance.
If anyone's gonna murder you, it's me.
I didn't know when you'd be back, so I ordered Chinese food.
You can really taste the Kung Pao.
Oh no, you're not getting rid of this.
I still think Porky's a murderer.
